champion.tips: CAMILLE TIPS AND TRICKS In team fights, don’t run directly towards the enemy. The best way to team fight for Camille is by flanking the enemy from the side and then using your Ultimate R on a carry. Whenever your Ultimate R is up, make sure you gank a lane. Your Ultimate R is incredibly strong and should result in a kill every time. Camille is really good at cheesing early ganks. After hitting level 2, look to gank a lane to blow an early enemy Flash.
champion.builds: THE BEST CAMILLE BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR JUNGLE IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Camille Jungle build, you should take Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Press the Attack as your keystone, followed by Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Coup de Grace in the primary tree, as well as Cosmic Insight and Magical Footwear in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Trinity Force as your first item, followed by Plated Steelcaps and Ravenous Hydra. For your last 3 items, you should build Spear of Shojin, Death's Dance and finish with Maw of Malmortius. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - E - W. Right now, this build has 51.5% winrate over 136 matches played. Optional Your second option for Camille Jungle build would be to take Smite and Ignite as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Fleet Footwork as your keystone, Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Coup de Grace in the primary tree, and Shield Bash with Bone Plating in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health in defense. The items for the build are Trinity Force, which you should build first, followed by Mercury's Treads as your second item and Profane Hydra as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Sterak's Gage, Guardian Angel and Unending Despair. The skill order for this build is Q - E - W. In the current patch, this build has a 44.7% win rate over 85 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Conqueror as your keystone, Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Last Stand in the primary tree, and Bone Plating with Shield Bash in the secondary tree, as well as Attack Speed, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Trinity Force as your first item, then Plated Steelcaps as a second item and Ravenous Hydra as a third item. You want to finish the build with Sundered Sky, Sterak's Gage and Chempunk Chainsword. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - E - W. This build is currently sitting at a 38.6% win rate across 57 matches played. Situational Camille Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Camille build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Camille runes page.
